assessments.name: Cased-Based Clinical Competencies
assessments.description: You will be assessed on 8 simulated clinical cases that will be performed in tutorials. Must pass (50%) each case to pass the unit (3 attempts allowed for each case).

assessments.name: IPL
assessments.description: IPL workshops with nursing students in week 5 and 12. Attendance and contribution at both workshops is mandatory.

assessments.name: Tutorials, Seminars and Workshops
assessments.description: Tutorial, seminar and workshop attendance and active participation. 85% attendance requirement is required. Lack of participation or inappropriate behaviour in class will be marked as 'Absent'.

assessments.name: Health Collaboration Challenge (HCC)
assessments.description: Part A: Production of group video and Role Description Document

assessments.name: Health Collaboration Challenge (HCC)
assessments.description: Part C: Completion of a team peer evaluation

assessments.name: Vaccination Training
assessments.description: You will have a vaccination workshop during Week 7 or 8. There will be mandatory online modules to complete prior to the workshop.

assessments.name: Mock Clinic Activity
assessments.description: MCA pitch video in Week 8 followed by MCA presentations in class in Week 10.

assessments.name: HMR Interview
assessments.description: A HMR interview will take place during the usual tutorial in Week 9. A HMR referral will be released one week prior.

assessments.name: Devices Workshop
assessments.description: Device workshop will occur in week 10 where students need to visit stations. A 'Devices Passport' demonstrating interaction at all stations is required to be submitted. Attendance and a completed Devices Passport is mandatory.

assessments.name: HMR Report
assessments.description: A HMR report will be prepared based on the HMR interview in Week 9. Must pass (50%) to pass the unit.

assessments.name: Weekly Placement
assessments.description: One reflection on a clinical task performed during placement, one case-based presentation, and a preceptor assessment. Must achieve a pass grade in the Preceptor Assessment (50%) and overall placement portfolio.
assessments.type: Peer or expert observation or supervision

assessments.name: CPD Portfolio
assessments.description: Collation of CPD activities in a portfolio of 10 or more points. All CPD requirements must be satisfied to pass the unit.
